info.title: Cost Accounting Standards (CAS / 48 CFR 9904) Coverage & DS-1 Disclosure Auditor API
info.description: Evaluates contractor award history and cost accounting practices under 48 CFR Chapter 99 (FAR Part 30 & FAR 52.230-1 through 52.230-6) to determine Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) exemptions, Modified CAS (CAS 401, 402, 405, 406), or Full CAS coverage (>= $50M threshold), audit CAS 401–420 compliance, draft Form CASB DS-1 (8-Part Disclosure Statement) narratives, and model FAR 52.230-6 General Dollar Magnitude (GDM) cost-impact remedies.

post.summary: Determine CAS Coverage (Full vs. Modified vs. Exempt) & Audit Form CASB DS-1 Disclosure Statements
post.description: Evaluates contractor award history and cost accounting practices under 48 CFR Chapter 99 (FAR Part 30 & FAR 52.230-1 through 52.230-6) to determine Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) exemptions, Modified CAS (CAS 401, 402, 405, 406), or Full CAS coverage (>= $50M threshold), audit CAS 401–420 compliance, draft Form CASB DS-1 (8-Part Disclosure Statement) narratives, and model FAR 52.230-6 General Dollar Magnitude (GDM) cost-impact remedies.

contract_awards_and_accounting_practices.description: Target contract value/type, prior-year net CAS-covered awards, small business status, indirect cost pools, and planned accounting changes.
contract_awards_and_accounting_practices.example: TARGET AWARD: $38.5M Negotiated DoD CPFF Engineering Contract. PRIOR YEAR CAS AWARDS: $56.2M net CAS-covered awards. PRACTICES: Fringe (30.8%) on Total Labor; Overhead (24.5%) on DL + Fringe; G&A (11.2%) on Total Cost Input (TCI). PLANNED CHANGE: Move Cloud SecOps Tooling ($620K/yr) from G&A to Engineering Overhead.

cas_coverage_and_disclosure_mode.description: CAS coverage determination and Form CASB DS-1 / DS-2 audit mode.

accounting_change_cost_impact_posture.description: FAR 52.230-6 cost-impact modeling posture (Unilateral, Desirable, or Required change).
